answer.rationale: The scenario describes a work-related amputation with in-patient hospitalization, learned of today. This is a clear recordable case under §1904.4(a) and §1904.7(a) (medical treatment beyond first aid, and specifically amputation/hospitalization). It must be entered on the OSHA 300 Log/301 within 7 calendar days per §1904.29(b)(3), and separately reported to OSHA within 24 hours per §1904.39(a)(2) due to the amputation and hospitalization triggers. No conflicting facts or missing predicates exist; the facts are sufficient to determine the applicable recordkeeping and reporting obligations.
